description.text: Program Description Students mainly study in the basic theories and knowledge in math, foundamental physics, physical electronics, optoelectronics, microelectronics. And they will take the basic training at information electronic experiment technology, computer technology, the ability to design, research and develop electronic materials, component and system. This program is designed to turn out highly-qualified professionals armed with a sound basic knowledge of theories and expertise in electronical materials, component, integrate circuit, developing and researching new technology, etc. Given the strong focus on Micro-Electronics, graduates will be particularly well equipped for employment in the micro-electronics industry. Main Courses: Fundamentals of Electric Circuits, Computer Architecture Foundation and Logical Design, Introduction to Electronical Science and Technology, Signal and System, Fundamentals of Electronic Circuits, Micro Computer System and Interface, Theory of Electromagnetic Fields, Semiconductor Physics, Photoelectron Physical Basis, Electronic Device, VLSI Design, Display Technology, Photoelectronic Technique, Fiber Optic Communications, Digital Signal Processing, etc.

duration.text: The Environmental Engineering at Chengdu University is a 4 Years long program for international students, taught in Chinese.

fees.text: Application Fee: $ 150 USD Service Fee: $ 50 USD Tuition fee: $ 1944 USD/per year ￥ 14000 CNY/per year

materials.text: Application Materials 1.Certificate of HSK Certificate of HSK (Chinese Proficiency Test) 2.Photocopy of valid passport With name, passport number & expiration date, and photo included 3.Passport photo A recent passport-sized photo of the applicant 4.High school academic transcript High school graduate certificate 5.Graduation certificate in languages other than Chinese or English should be translated into Chinese or English and be certified by notarization.

requirements.text: Entry Requirements 1.High school graduate 2.HSK level 4 or above
